title: PolynomialDualityPresentationData
statement: For a scheme morphism $f:X\to S$ [def-pc-scheme], a polynomial chart consists of an open $U\subset X$, an integer $n\geq0$, an open immersion $P\to\mathbf A^n_S$ and a closed immersion $i:U\to P$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose structural composite is $f|_U$. Its coefficient is $\Omega^n_{P/S}[n]$, using the relative differential sheaf [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf] and its sheaf exterior power [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. Its model is derived sheaf coinduction of this coefficient, an object of the derived category over $(P,i_*\mathcal O_U)$ [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category], using the evaluation-at-one adjunction [lem-sc-sheaf-coinduction-adjunction] and derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. For commutative rings $R,A$ and $\varphi:R\to A$, put $T_n=\bigwedge^n\Omega^1_{R[x_0,\ldots,x_{n-1}]/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra] and [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] and $K_p=R\operatorname{Hom}_P(A,T_n[n])$ with its coinduced $A$-action [def-trf-derived-coinduction] for each polynomial quotient $p:P\twoheadrightarrow A$ over $R$. A polynomial presentation system for $M\in D(A)$ is a family $M\cong K_p$ for all these quotients. Its transition for adjoining a last variable, evaluated at any lift $g\in P$, is the composite coinduction-counit comparison with the coefficient contraction determined by the short exact sequence given by multiplication by $t-g$ and the ordered volume quotient. Equivalently its coefficient adjunct is the shifted boundary of that exact sequence, with the dual of $t-g$ paired with $d(t-g)$ sent to $1$. Its coordinate comparisons are the coinduction adjuncts of the exterior maps sending every wedge of universal derivatives to the wedge of their images under the polynomial automorphism. Define comparisons between two presentations through their common $M$. All constructions include zero variables and zero rings. Exact affine associated-sheaf functors are supplied by the actual tilde/Gamma adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction] and its recorded finite-limit preservation [lem-sc-tilde-preserves-finite-limits]. Include the exactness proofs for the scalar-forgetting functor, its canonical ringed-space algebra map, and the derived evaluation adjunction against the actual derived direct image [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image].
